ja.title: AI創薬のボトルネックはどこにあるか
ja.summary: AI創薬の実験接続、公開業績、臨床移行を点検し、実験量と開発判断に使える証拠を区別する。

en.title: Where are the bottlenecks in AI-enabled drug discovery?
en.summary: A Japanese essay reviewing experimental workflows, industry disclosures and clinical progress. It distinguishes experimental throughput from evidence useful for development decisions; revenue growth and individual clinical advances do not establish an AI-driven supply shortage or a causal improvement in clinical success.
en.seo_title: Where AI drug discovery bottlenecks move
en.seo_description: Public research and industry reports separate faster molecular design, experimental demand and evidence for clinical development decisions.
